cards.name: Compass
cards.text: Reveals all secrets within a battle square, making their tiles sparkle.

cards.name: Cannon
cards.text: Destroys boulders, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Railway Track
cards.text: Reconnects severed railways, removing locks on certain adjacent squares so that they can be opened normally.

cards.name: Whirlwind
cards.text: Spins windmills, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: Golden Train
cards.text: Activates a Engine Power that removes Warrior restrictions from all battles.

cards.name: Fishing Rod
cards.text: Catches Fish in bodies of water, unlocking a secret reward.

cards.name: S.S. Linebeck
cards.text: Activates a Captain Power that increases the KO count battle rank.

cards.name: Cyclone Slate
cards.text: Causes Golden Frogs to reveal a warping symbol, revealing enemies in that square.

cards.name: Steel Train
cards.text: Activates a Engine Power that adds random "Recommended" Elements to all battles.

cards.name: Spirit Train
cards.text: Activates a Engine Power that causes all routes to be unlocked by battle rank C.

cards.name: Iron Ship
cards.text: Activates a Captain Power that increases the completion time battle rank.

cards.name: Golden Ship
cards.text: Activates a Captain Power that increases the damage taken battle rank.
